check: EventBus worker, alert handler, and durable loopback notification delivery across disposable PostgreSQL stop/start
limitations: Only the event, durable-handler, and notification table migrations were replayed in the disposable database; the full ordered schema ledger was not applied.

The real allowlisted alert-notification handler ran in its spawned child process. A temporary HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 accepted the two notification deliveries; no remote provider was contacted.

Both notification outbox rows and their latest attempt rows were verified as succeeded. Each loopback request carried its matching durable notification ID as the Idempotency-Key, and the two keys were distinct.
The PostgreSQL container had no volume and was bound only to loopback.
